Learn to distinguish related nouns and verbs with different endings. In these British English word pairs, nouns use -ce or -cy, while verbs use -se or -sy. Teach using [advice, advise], [device, devise], [practice, practise], [licence, license], [prophecy, prophesy]. The child learns to identify whether the sentence requires a noun or verb and select the correct spelling. This is a pattern found in these word pairs, not a universal spelling rule.
